capabilities.name: Explicit Rust engine selection and positional ordering
capabilities.probe: Force each available engine; inspect declared row order and verify correspondence after reorderable operations.
capabilities.refusal_rule: An engine choice and ordering guarantee cannot be inferred from Python defaults.

capabilities.name: Streaming partition, prefix, halo, and segment contracts
capabilities.probe: Repartition one logical dataset at every small boundary and force native adapters used by that engine.
capabilities.refusal_rule: Unavailable kernel partition contracts exclude that streaming lowering.

capabilities.name: Spill permission, quota, control scope, and cleanup
capabilities.probe: Determine actual Rust controls and their process/query scope; no-spill, quota exhaustion, cancellation and conflicting concurrent policies.
capabilities.refusal_rule: Default no unrequested disk; strict profile refuses an unenforceable guarantee.

capabilities.name: Operation-specific out-of-core execution
capabilities.probe: Record which operations actually spill in the selected revision and which retain unbounded backend state.
capabilities.refusal_rule: Do not infer join/group-by spilling from sorting support.

capabilities.name: Empty/nested validity and schema semantics
capabilities.probe: Check null versus empty explosion, parent validity, zero-width transpose, explicit dtype and row/cardinality results.
capabilities.refusal_rule: Combobulate schemas remain authoritative even when backend empty results use Null dtype.

capabilities.name: Dtype and extension-metadata planning specialization
capabilities.probe: Identify public Rust hooks; specialize one typed operation and preserve logical metadata/validation across import.
capabilities.refusal_rule: Backend plan-time callbacks are not Rust compile-time execution; extension tags are not domain proofs.

capabilities.name: Deterministic plugin optimizer participation
capabilities.probe: Compare enabled/disabled sharing for pure total code, then a deterministic-fallible guarded callback.
capabilities.refusal_rule: Determinism alone cannot authorize speculation, skipped failures or merged effects.

capabilities.name: Physical node to source provenance
capabilities.probe: Bind actual physical/IR attribution to Combobulate source origin; inject a fused-kernel failure.
capabilities.refusal_rule: Retain own source mapping when an optional backend hook is unavailable.

capabilities.name: Strict table boundary and extension representation
capabilities.probe: Test unequal-length concat, lossy membership coercion, unknown extension storage and logical ordering.
capabilities.refusal_rule: Explicit local policies remain authoritative; Map does not replace ordered segments.
